description: As an incumbent house representative, I serve as the Chair of the Special Committee for Education in the Democratic Caucus and as a member of the Education Committee in the Georgia House. I advocate fiercely for public education and want to continue my work by winning my next term in 2026. I was instrumental in the state fully funding the QBE formula and now I want to help lead the effort to update Georgia’s funding formula.
title: ABOUT | Re-elect Doreen Carter | GA District 93
